findings.issue: The departure memo's predicted reaction ("others will laugh and say 'Half? Ha! I'm at quarter efficiency!'") is presented as a post-leak historical event ("when the memo leaked, plenty of insiders laughed and said"). The corpus supports the prediction, not the reported reaction.
findings.recommendation: Rephrase to match the memo's own framing, e.g. "as I wrote in the memo itself, others would laugh and say 'Half? Ha! I'm at quarter efficiency!'"
findings.resolution: Rephrased to the memo's own predictive framing: "I predicted in the memo itself that some would scoff and contend we were doing just fine, but others would laugh and say 'Half? Ha! I'm at quarter efficiency!'" — matching meta-departure-memo-2022.md; no other file repeated the post-leak claim (persona.md line 165 quotes the memo verbatim, which was already correct)

findings.issue: routing_keywords covers 14 of 16 topic files directly; demonstration-over-paperwork.md and user-value-equation.md have no corresponding keyword (nearest matches are 'hype deflation' and 'developer productivity', which do not capture demo-culture or user-value routing queries).
findings.recommendation: Add 'demonstration over paperwork' (or 'demo culture') and 'user value' (or 'product value') to routing_keywords.
findings.resolution: Added routing keywords derived from the two topic files: 'demonstration over paperwork, demo culture, convincing regulators, prototype versus document' (demonstration-over-paperwork.md) and 'user value, product value, pile of value, friction reduction, pricing for reach' (user-value-equation.md); all 16 topic files now have direct keyword coverage

findings.issue: PERSONA_SPEC.yaml's intake comment states the Sutton-attribution caution is 'handled inside the topic file (credits the Alberta Plan / RL doctrine context to Sutton)', but the topic file never names Sutton. No Sutton-specific framework (Alberta Plan, reward-is-enough) is actually absorbed — the file claims only Carmack's own positions, all traceable to his solo sources — so this is a spec-comment/file mismatch, not attribution leakage.
findings.recommendation: Either add a one-line credit to Richard Sutton for the RL-from-experience research doctrine in the Core Concept, or correct the spec comment to say the caution was handled by omitting Sutton's frameworks.
findings.resolution: Corrected PERSONA_SPEC.yaml to match the topic file: the intake comment now says the caution was handled by omission (no Alberta Plan, no 'reward is enough'; only Carmack's own positions claimed), and the agi-from-experience framework note was updated to the same effect; the topic file itself was already clean and unchanged
